originalTitle: Tekken 8 Yujiro Reveal Trailer | EVO France 2026
content: Tekken 8 Yujiro Reveal Trailer from EVO France 2026 showcases Yujiro Hanma from the Baki franchise in an exciting crossover with Bandai Namco Entertainment's legendary fighting game. Revealed during EVO France 2026, this trailer introduces the fearsome martial artist known as the Strongest Creature on Earth, bringing his overwhelming strength, intimidating presence, and brutal fighting techniques into the world of TEKKEN 8. Yujiro Hanma is one of the most powerful and recognizable characters from Baki, the martial arts manga and anime series created by Keisuke Itagaki. As the father of Baki Hanma, Yujiro is feared for his extraordinary physical abilities, mastery of martial arts, and ruthless personality. His appearance in TEKKEN 8 brings together two franchises celebrated for their intense martial arts battles, larger-than-life fighters, and spectacular combat. Developed by Bandai Namco Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, TEKKEN 8 features intense 3D fighting gameplay powered by Unreal Engine 5, an aggressive combat system built around the Heat mechanic, and a diverse roster of legendary fighters.
